name: phase0_sampling
description: Quantifies what edge-triggered sampling buys over the old fixed-window
sampler, as a methods result for the thesis.
The old sampler used a 2.5M-cycle busy-wait, at or below the RAPL update
interval: 9.2% of samples in out-1228-1527 read exactly zero energy, and
the analysis then discarded those zeros while keeping the double-length
windows that followed them. Same victim, same conditions, both samplers.

runs.label: fixed_sampling
runs.comment: The old 2.5M-cycle window, for the zero-tick and variance comparison.
